title: Faculty of Science | KPGU
content: the Director Dr.Rita Mahapatra Director, KSS (Faculty of Science) Krishna School of Science (KSS) at Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara, is built on a single conviction - science drives societal progress. As one of Gujarat's emerging centers of science education and research, KSS prepares graduates who are ready to contribute meaningfully to the scientific world across biotechnology, chemistry, physics, and beyond.
